publication_constraints.node.timeout: Tasks only; spec.timeout_requires_task on controls. defaults.timeout applies only to tasks; nested wait/approval timeouts and execution timeout remain supported.
publication_constraints.approval.allow_agents: Requires min: 1 (spec.agent_approval_requires_min_one); agent DecisionApplied is separate from human signatures; destructive-path prohibition remains.
